fields.overview: Builder: Grok-1 (Matthew's PC, D:\Git\grok1). Checker: Grok-Check (wf check --as Grok-Check). Wave 4 of the stage plan (section 15.4) and wave 1 of the Grok builder queue: this page is the render.rs side, beside 0408 which is the cmd.rs side. They share no file. Start is returns a823ee284574be3d9f6247925b9088137a27a539. 0403 is closed. This pack is template 4, so the return must fill the design review line. Lab is 90.50.10.0701. The lab trial tests/lab_0407.rs is not this page's file. This page writes tests/page_0407.rs (section 11.7). Code re-read at a823ee28: face 00 is printed by face00 in src/render.rs:355. It lists title, person, prime, grant and the log head. It does not print type: band or a contents list. page_kind is src/addr.rs:73. BandHead is PP00 at or above 0100. Do not change src/addr.rs. The plan's done-when says a dropped page shows as dropped. wf has no dropped state in the log (retire is page 0409, later). Do not invent one.
fields.stop if: another file must change, including src/addr.rs, src/cmd.rs, src/lib.rs, src/page.rs, or a hand edit of pages under the door. The only way to show dropped is to invent a state the log does not have. A rule above reads two ways.
fields.w01: In src/render.rs face00 (line 355 at a823ee28), when this page is a band head (page_kind BandHead, src/addr.rs:73), print a line type: band and a contents list. Build the list by reading the other page folders of the same band under the run folder's pages directory. Do not hand-write the list. Each line names the page address and the state that page's log already has. A page that is not a band head gets no type: band line and no contents list.
fields.w02: Add tests/page_0407.rs. It must build on Windows: no std::os::unix, and no check command that is only true, grep, or test (stage plan 11.7). Show a band door listing each page in its band with its state, and a non-door page with no list. Do not add a dropped state. If a test cannot show dropped from the log as it is, stop and say so.
